requirement: A voice switch the database cannot read for a while does not end live voice sessions; Voice off mid-phrase sends no partial

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: every live session queried ui_setting each second and ended on any query error
oracle.invariant: S1: the session keeps running. S2: the reading keeps running while the read fails, and is cut when the switch reads false. S3: the session ends 'stopped' with settled false. S4: the end reason is 'provider', not 'provider-busy'.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a running session outlives a voice switch the database cannot read for a while
Voice turned off mid-phrase ends the session as unconfirmed, so the page does not send the partial
a reading under way outlives a voice switch the database cannot read; Voice turned off still cuts it
the service's errors end the session with a reason the page can word
